extraction.notes: Three months ended Dec 31, 2023 column. Core subtotal is AIR's Run-Rate FFO (94,298); the Pro forma FFO subtotal (94,388) falls between the Pro forma adjustments and the cash swap / casualty-legal items and is not separately recorded (verified: 67,855 + 26,533 = 94,388; 94,388 - 2,857 + 2,767 = 94,298). AFFO starts from Run-Rate FFO. Reported per share: Run-Rate FFO $0.64 and Run-Rate AFFO $0.58, both reproduced by 146,514 shares. NAREIT FFO per share is not printed in this table, so ffo reported per share is null (67,855 / 146,514 = 0.46 is not a printed figure). Business transformation costs mapped to severance_restructuring; casualty and legal expense in excess of run-rate mapped to casualty. Capital Replacements are deducted in AFFO, so no separate recurring capex disclosure is needed.
